༄༅/ /ma gcig gi bka' tshoms bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ma gcig gi bka' tshoms bzhugs so/ /

oṃ swa sti/ mi smra mi bsam bsam du med pa dang*/ /yul 'das dmigs med dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gcod kyi bka' tshoms chen mo 'di/ /gcod ni rnam rtog rang bzhin gcod/ /bka' ni bshad pa'i tshoms su bshad/ /'gro la phan phyir yi ger bkod/ /bdud kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems/ /yul snang cir yang rig pa la/ /zhen cing chags na bdud kyis zin/ /sems la yul du bzung bas bslad/ /bdud la rnam pa bzhi ru dbye/ /thogs bcas bdud dang thogs med bdud/ /dga' brod bdud dang snyems byed bdud/ /de yang snyems byed bdud du 'dus/ /thogs bcas bdud la rnam mang yang*/ /dbang po'i sgo la snang ba la/ /dgag sgrub dpyad pa thogs bcas bdud/ /nges par bzung bas 'khor bar bcings/ / gzugs ni gzugs kyi ngo bos stong*/ /gzugs la dngos por ma bzungs bas/ /gzugs la ma chags stong par sgoms/ /gzugs la nges par ma bzung bas/ /rtag par 'dzin pa'i bdud las grol/ /stong pa yid la ma bsgoms pas/ /chad par lta ba'i bdud las grol/ /gzugs snang dgag tu mi btub ste/ /nges par ma bzung rang snang sems/ /sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg / yid la sogs pa de bzhin no/ /yid ni thogs med bdud yin te/ /dbang po'i sgo las byung ba rnams/ /thogs bcas bdud du 'dus pa yin/ /dbang po'i ngo khar snang ba rnams/ /rang grol dgongs pas thad kar bcad/ /dbyer med gti mug chen por 'gyur/ /thogs med bdud kyi byung tshul ni/ /yid yul byung tshor 'azang dang ngan/ /rang gi rtog pas dbye ba rnams/ /thogs med bdud du bstan pa yin/ /rang byung sems nyid ma rtogs pas/ /lhar bzung lha ru 'dzin pa dang*/ / 'dre ngan 'dre ru 'dzin pa dang*/ /de ni yid yul re dogs rnams/ /rang bdud rang la langs pa yin/ /sems nyid klong chen dang gsal la/ /dran rtog cir yang 'char ba yin/ /dper na rgya mtsho g.yo med las/ /rlabs la sogs pa 'byung ba bzhin/

/de ltar rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /bcas bcos mi bya rang sar bzhag /phan gnod mi nus rang sar grol/ /chos nyid dbyings nas rang shar la/ /phrag dog dgag sgrub byar mi rigs/ /dgag sgrub ma byas rang byung sems/ /dga' brod bdud kyi byung tshul ni/ /thun mong bdud dang mchog gi bdud/ /rig 'khrul sems las byung ba yin/ /gnyan sar 'dre yi ma tshug pas/ /rlom sems skyes pas dga' brod dang*/ /byin rlabs nus pa'i brda byung bas/ /bsod nams nor rdzas g.yeng ba'i bdud/ khe grags snyan grags spro ba'i bdud/ /lha 'dres dngos grub ster ba dang*/ /bu dang 'dza' bshes 'khor 'dus dang*/ /dga' zhing brod pas dga' brod bdud/ /yon tan ci byung ci shar yang*/ / yul sems gnyis su med pa'i blos/ /yon tan bdag tu mi bzung ste/ / rmi lam dag gi yul bzhin du/ /rang sems zhen pa med pa'i blos/ / mtshar po byad kyis rang mdzes ltar/ /rang byung rang la brgyan pa yin/ /de la rlom sems skye ru med/ /skye na rig 'khrul 'dzin pas bslad/ /'dzin med rang grol gcod mchog yin/ /blo ldan rnams kyi thugs la sbos/ /mchog gi bdud la rnam pa gnyis/ /lam dang 'bras bu gnyis su bstan/ /spros bral lta bas brod pa dang*/ / mnyam nyid bsgoms pas brod pa dang*/ /rtog med spyod pas brod pa dang*/ / nyams len lam gyis brod pa dang*/ /bag tsam yul du spyad pas na/ /lam du mi 'gro bdud kyi las/ /lta sgom brda ru bstan pa la/ /nges par yid la bya ba med/ / ma 'gag cir yang 'char ba las/ /lta ba'i bsam pa mi 'cha' bar/ / nyams shar phyogs med dbyings su skyur/ /mi lta ba ni lta ba'i mchog / rang byung sems nyid ma gtogs pa/ /sgom mkhan gcig gis sgom du med/ /ci byung rang shar byung tshor rnams/ /lhan ne lhang nge lham mer bzhag /mi 'gyur bas na lhan ne ba/ / nges par rtogs pas lhang nge ba/ /rang sar grol bas lham me ba/ /

dper na mar la mar bzhag bzhin/ /ma bsgom pa yi bsam gtan ni/ /de ni sgom pa'i mchog yin no/ /rang spyod shugs 'byung rang grol la/ /ched du byas nas spang du med/ / nyams shar gnyen pos bcos su med/ /ci yang rang byung yin shes na/ / rang la rang grol 'gag pa med/ /rtogs pa'i khyad par btsan pas na/ /nges par spyod pa dgag tu med/ /ma rtogs spyod pa mi bya ste/ / gdams pa 'di y-i bzhed bzhed lugs kyis/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs gdeng ldan gyis/ /rnam rtog dag la thog rdzis bya/ /rim gyis byin rlabs zhugs nas ni/ / nges par rtogs pa 'char bar 'gyur/ /nges par gsung pa'i gdam ngag 'di/ / gcod yul kun las khyad par 'phags/ /mi gcod spyod pa mchog tu gsungs/ / gang yang nyams su ma blangs na/ /de nyid nyams su blang pa yin/ /nyams ni shes bya blo yi nyams/ /yang dag don la myong rgyu med/ /skye med log nas blangs rgyu med/ / nyams su blangs bas chos nyid nyams/ /blo snang yul du spyad pa 'o/ / yul du ma chags nyams len ni/ /thar pa'i lam mchog bla ma'i zhabs/ / 'bras bu yid bzhin nor bu bzhin/ /mchog gi bdud ni 'di bzhin no/ /nyan thos rang rgyal la sogs pa'i/ /grub mtha' theg pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /sku gsum nges par 'thob 'dod pas/ /'dod pa dang bcas brod pa'i bdud/ /lus ngag yid gsum rang bzhin la/ /sku gsum 'bras bu rtag pa las/ /sangs rgyas logs nas sgrub tu med/ /rang las spang ste btsal gyur na/ /bskal pa bye ba du mar yang*/ /bsgrubs pas thob par mi 'gyur bas/ /mi btsal mi sgrub rang sar bzhag /re ba med pa gcod kyi mchog /mi re dogs pa'i mtha' dang bral/ / 'dzin pa'i thag pa bcad pa las/ /nges par sangs rgyas ga la mchis/ /bdud la bzhi ru dbye lags kyang*/ /snyems byed bdud du 'dus pa yin/ /dngos po'i yul la snyems zhugs pas/ /thogs bcas bdud du bstan pa yin/ /dngos po yul gyi chags sdang rnams/

/rtsa ba snyems su rtogs tsam na/ /dper na rtsig gseb du ba yang*/ /thab kyis me bsad rang zhi ltar/ /snyems thag chod pas dngos 'dzin grol/ /'gog pa bzhin du yul mi dgag /rtsa bral rtogs na thogs bcas bdud/ /nges par bdud rnams chod pa yin/ /dper na sgyu ma'i mkhan po bzhin/ /snang yang chags sems mi 'byung ngo*/ /de bas snyems kyi thag pa bcad/ /bcad pas chod pa ma yin te/ /rtsa bral rtogs na gzung mi thub/ / chos dbyings klong du grol bar nges/ /rtsis gdab med pa'i la bzla gces/ / thogs med bdud kyang snyems su 'dus/ /dug lnga la sogs nyon mongs dang*/ / mthong med 'dre la 'jigs pa dang*/ /dngos med lha la re ba dang*/ /de ltar yid yul re dogs rnams/ /snyems byed las byung snyems kyi bdud/ /zhe sdang rang sar grol ba yang*/ /snyems kyi rtsa ba chod las byung*/ /btso sreg dmyal ba'i bdud las thar/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes thob/ /'dod chags rang sar grol ba yang*/ /snyems kyi rtsa ba chod las byung*/ /bkres skom yi dwags bdud las thar// so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes thob/ /gti mug rang sar dag pa yang*/ /snyems kyi rtsa ba chod las byung*/ /bkol spyod byol song bdud las thar/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes thob/ /phrag dog rang sar grol ba yang*/ / snyems kyi rtsa ba chod las byung*/ /'pho 'gyur mi yi bdud las thar/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes thob/ /nga rgyal rang sar grol ba yang*/ /snyems kyi rtsa ba chod las byung*/ /'thab rtsod sdug bsngal bdud las thar/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes thob/ /snyems thag ma chod sdug bsngal rgyu/ /snyems chod ye shes rang sar grol/ /de bas thams cad snyems la 'dus/ /gangs dkar stod kyi seng ge bzhin/ /nyam nga bag tsha mi byed par// snyaims med gdeng dang ldan gyur na/ /snang srid lha 'dre ldang mi nus/ /brgya la langs kyang gdams ngag gsal/ /rang gi cho 'phrul yin shes na/

/nges par rtsal sbyong chen por 'gro/ /dran rgyun bcad nas mi bsgom ste/ /rang shar rtogs pas gcod pa yin/ /nad rims la sogs de bzhin mtshungs/ /rtsa bral rtog pa gcod pa ni/ /gdams ngag kun las khyad par 'phags/ /rtogs kyang thad kar ma bcad na/ /mtshon rnon tsha ngar bo ba 'dra/ /lta bas mi skyob nyams kyis 'chings/ /lta spyod 'dzoms pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /dpa' bo'i lag na mtshon thogs 'dra/ /dgra dpungs bdud rnams 'joms pa yin/ / bdud rnams snyems med dbyings su 'joms/ / e ma ho/ rang snyems chod pas bdud rnams zhi/ /rtsa bral rtogs pas mngon sangs rgyas/ /de yang rang dwangs lhug par 'jog /kun gyis de bzhin bzhag par bya/ /dga' brod bdud kyang snyems su 'dus/ /thun mong chos la dga' brod dang*/ /'bras bu mchog la dga' brod pa/ /rang gi snyems las byung ba yin/ /nges par chags pas bdud du 'gyur/ /chags pa med pa'i rang shar ni/ /snyems med chos sku'i rgyan du gsungs/ /sku gsum 'bras bu rang yin pas/ / gzhan du brod pa skyes mi dgos/ /'khor ba rang sar grol ba las/ /myang 'das log nas sgrub mi dgos/ /rtog pa'i rang gzugs shar ba las/ /rtog med ched du bsgom mi dgos/ /de bas thams cad snyems su 'dus/ /snyems thag gcod pa nga yis smras/ /rang sar bzhag pa kun nas gsungs/ /rang sa'i sems la ngos bzungs nas/ /dpe don gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ /gdams ngag thob pa'i rnal 'byor kun/ /bye 'us phruu gu gso ba bzhin/ /gdams ngag mchus skyel byas gyur na/ /ston bye'u ltog grir shi ba 'dra/ /rang nyid 'khor bar 'khyams par nges/ /'bri bzang be 'u gso ba bzhin/ /rang 'grangs rogs kyi don byas na/ /be chung la sogs 'tshau ba bzhin/ /rang gis snyems thag chod gyur na/ /sems nyid nges par grol bar 'gyur/ /gzhan don 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /mkha' la khyung chen lding ba bzhin/ /gling bzhi bya rtsol med par mthong*/

/ngam grog g.yang la nyam nga med/ /bya bran la sogs zil gyis gnon/ / de bzhinanyams kyi thag chod pas/ /bdud nyid rtsa ba med par rtogs/ /'dre dang bdud sogs zil gyis gnon/ /ngan song gsum la nyam nga med/ /nges par rtsa bral ma rtogs par/ /rgyu 'bras chos la spyod pa ni/ /sgong bzhag yal ga g.yab pa 'dra/ /rtsa bral rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dran rtog glo bur shes pa na/ /spang blang med pa'i chos la spyod/ /gzugs mthong sems kyis sku ru lta/ /sgra thos sems kyis gsung du lta/ /ci bsam sems kyis thugs su lta/ / 'du 'bral med pa'i don la lta/ /lha khang nang gi lder so bzhin/ /'dug tshul bcas dang zhal 'dzum yang*/ /mi sems sems pa'i tshul med bzhin/ /rang lus gang bder 'dug byas nas/ /mi bsam bsam par mi bya 'o/ /bsam pa'i yul ni de nyid min/ /de bas mi bsam ngang la bzhag /byung tshor dran rtog rjes mi bcad/ / mkha' la glog 'gyu rang log bzhin/ /rnam rtog byung yang de nyid yin/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'jings bzhin du/ /ngang gis g.yo med ngang la bzhag /rkyen snang rtog pa rlabs bzhin du/ /ngang gis chos nyid dbyings su bsgyur/ /bcos bslad mi bya rgyal ba'i bka'/ /bcos na chos byed bdud yin pas/ /nges par rang sar bzhag pa yin/ /skyes bu nad kyis gzir ba bzhin/ / tshogs drug lhug par bzhag pa yin/ /bya ba zin pa'i skyes bu bzhin/ /blo bde'i ngang la bzhag pa yin/ /bu chung a ma mthong ba bzhin/ /snang yang nus pa med par bzhag /rig pa rang lus ro khur la/ /gnyan sa la sogs 'jigs gnas su/ /chags med tshul gyis bskyur la bzhag /rig pa yum chen klong du bzhag /dran rtog shes rig ci byung yang*/ /yum chen sprul pa nyid dgongs la/ / yum sras 'khor ba'i gnas mi 'dzin/ /glen pa lto yis 'grangs pa bzhin/ /'du shes rnam par bshigs la bzhag /'khor spangs mya ngan 'da' bar nges/ / e ma ho/ bya rtsol med de dgongs pa longs/

/sgo srung khro bo khro mo yang*/ khro zhing gtum pa 'dra na yang*/ /rgyud la nyon mongs ma skye zhing*/ /brtul zhugs nges par che ba la/ /zhe 'dod rtog pa med par spyod/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas bar chad 'dul/ /zhe 'dod med pa de nyid lam/ /mtsho la nya mo 'phyo ba bzhin/ / 'dzin bya med par nya la la/ /skyi ser ri rtsibs gcod pa bzhin/ /zhe sdang zhen med rtsis las 'das/ /rang gis rang la spyod pa la/ /snyems med snyems byed zhugs mi dgos/ /rang la 'dzin pa med par spyod/ /rmi lam dus kyi dgra de yang*/ /rang las byung ba ma dgongs sam/ /yi dam lha yi dngos grub kyang*/ / sems la sems kyis bsgoms las byung*/ /de bas rang min gzhan ma yin/ / rang snang rang la gnod pa las/ /gzhan yul 'brel med gnod mi nus/ / dper na rgya gar dug sbrul bzhin/ /mar la dkar po ma bsgrubs kyang*/ /mar ngo shes nas dkar po grub/ /nges par mar ngo shes tsam na/ /dkar po log nas sgrub tu med/ /des na rang sems ngo shes nas/ /sangs rgyas log nas sgrub tu med/ /nges par sems ngo shes tsa na/ /sangs rgyas gzhan nas bsgrub mi dgos/ /snyems sangs rtsa bral kun las rgyal/ /de bas log nas sgrub tu med/ /de ltar rtogs pas bdud rnams zhi/ /de yang rang byung rang zhi yin/ / rig med gti mug chos dbyings las/ /yul du rig cing bzung bas 'khrul/ / dbyer med gcig las rig 'byung bas/ khams gsum gnas su 'khrul pa yin/ /rigs drug gnas su 'khor ba yin/ /de ni rang bzhin rig 'khrul lo/ / lha chos theg pa'i rim pa yang*/ /lta sgom 'bras bu rig pas 'khrul/ /chad pa cang med yul du rig /rtag pa 'gyur med yul du rig /nyan thos gzung 'dzin yul du rig /rang rgyal rten 'brel stong par rig /sems tsam rig pa sems su rig /dbu mas spros bral stong par rig /pha rgyud bde gsal rlung du rig /ma rgyud bde stong rlung du rig

/thabs dang shes rab gnyis med rig / phyag chen blo las 'das par rig /rdzogs chen ye yin chen mo rig /de ltar rig pa thams cad ni/ /yul du rig pa'i rig pa yin/ /yul can rnams ni de nyid min/ /yul med sems la rig pa med/ /gang rig pa yi rig pas 'chings/ /de bas rig med gti mug 'di/ /ye shes chen por rgyal bas gsungs/ /ma rig yul med 'khrul pa sangs/ /yul rnams blo yi btang tsam na/ / snyems thag ma lus chod pa yin/ /yul med rig pa ci la snyems/ /'khrul pa'i sems la mi 'dzin na/ /'dzin med rig pa ci shar yang*/ /ched du ma byas rang byung yin/ /de ltar dgongs na nam yang yin/ /yang dag don gyi yum chen de/ / 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi yang yin/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis kyang*/ / ma mdzad skye med gzhi ru byung*/ /ma byas 'dus ma byas pa yin/ /skye ba med pa 'di shes nas/ /skye med gzhi la byed mkhan med/ /ma byas gzhi yi gol sa chod/ / ma byas 'dus ma byas pa yin/ /mi byed lam du nges par 'gro /snang stong yid la ma byas na/ /rtag chad med par lam du 'gro /gnyis 'dzin yid la ma byas na/ / skye mched mu bzhi'i bdud las thar/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa rang sar dag /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes sogs/ /gang yang yid la ma byas na/ khams gsum gnas las nges par grol/ /'khor ba snang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang yang yid la ma byas pas/ /bag chags mi 'byung sa lam rdzogs/ /yid la mi byed lam mchog tu/ /bdag ma grub pas kun ma grub/ /sna tshogs bkag pas mi khegs so/ /dper na rmi lam yul bzhin no/ /sad pa'i dus na mi snang bzhin/ /bdag med rtogs pas dngos 'dzin grol/ /phyi rol 'dre gzugs rang nyid 'khrul/ /

btag pa tsam de bzhag byas la/ /mi phod gang yin thog tu 'khur/ /dug nad dug gis 'dzin pa dang*/ /rmi lam gtar sreg byed pa dang*/ /gdon chen mtha' la gtad pa gces/ /nad pa 'dre la gtad pas srog gcod rang sar grol/ / skyel ma dgra la bcol bas 'jigs med btsan sar bskyal/ /lam khyer rkyen la byas pas mi mthun 'gal rkyen med/ /rkyen ngan srid du bcad pas phug na dgra bo med/ /'dzin pa bdud yin 'du shes rnam par bshig /rtsol ba nad yin bya byed ma byed zhog /dogs pa 'dre yin sems nyid gar bzhag yin/ /phung po ro yin 'dre la gzan du bskyur/ /skyur mkhan sems yin glod la zhog /klod mkhan sems yin chod la thongs/ /gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ / sangs rgyas bgyi ba ji ltar bgyi/ /de ru 'gro na ji ltar 'gro zhus pas/ sangs rgyas bya ba'i yin tshul ni/ /'dzin pa bya ba kun sangs nas/ /skye med rang bzhin ye nas rgyas/ /sangs rgyas zhes ni de la bya/ /de ru 'gro lugs bstan pa ni/ / sangs rgyas bya ba'i mtshon pa ni/ /'khor ba 'jig pa'i thabs su bstan/ / sangs rgyas skye med bla dgas yin/ /snga rabs 'das dang gzhan gyis kyang*/ / 'dzin pa rang sar grol ba las/ /sangs rgyas sa la phyin pa med/ /da ltar bzhugs pa rnams kyis kyang*/ /'dzin pa rang sar grol ba las/ /sangs rgyas sa la 'gro rgyu med/ / e ma ho/ rigs kyi bu/ sangs rgyas thob byar ma byed cig /byis pa'i blo phyir ma 'brang zhig /skye med dmigs par ma byed cig /'khor bar dogs par ma byed cig /rnam rtog gzugs su ma 'dzin zhig /mi rtog sgom par ma byed cig /ye nas sems nyid skye med la/ /rtsol bas nyams su ma len cig /chos nyid gdal ba chen po la/ /dmigs pas sdud par ma byed cig /'khor 'das gnyis su med pa las/ /'khor bar 'dzin par ma byed cig /mya ngan 'das 'dod 'khor ba yin/ /ma re ma rtogs rigs kyi bu/ /ma dgag ma dpyod rigs kyi bu/

/gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /'o na mi lta mi spyod mi bsgom mam/ /zhus pas/ e ma ho/ rigs kyi bu/ don la blta ru med pa la/ /lta byed bkrol ba'i gang zag de/ /ma nor lta ba yin par gsungs/ /don la bsgom du ma mchis pas/ /sgom byed mkhan po grol ba de/ /ma nor sgom pa yin par gsungs/ /don la spyad pa'i yul med pas/ /spyod byed mkhan po grol ba de/ / ma nor spyod pa yin pa gsungs/ /pha rol phyin pa'i 'bras bu la/ /grub pa til tsam yod ma yin/ /grub med mkhan po grol ba de/ /ma nor 'bras bu yin par gsungs/ /de lta bu yi don rnyed na/ /re dogs 'ching bas bcing mi 'gyur/ / ji ltar byas kyang chos nyid klong*/ /gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ / 'o na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la/ gzhan don 'byung ngam mi 'byung zhus pas/ rtog dang bcas pa'i gzhan don de/ /sems kyi nus pa'i stobs su gsungs/ / sangs rgyas sems can don byed pa/ /dper na nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /rtog pa med bzhin don 'byung ba/ /rang rtog 'dzin pa med pa la/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /sems can rnams kyi bde skyid dang*/ /dam chos rnams kyi longs spyod dang*/ /grub thob rnams kyi dngos grub dang*/ /rtogs ldan rnams kyi rtogs pa dang*/ /lo tog char chu dus 'byung dang*/ /mdor na longs spyod thams cad kyang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan yin/ /zhes gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /rang la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan 'byung bar bgyi na ji ltar bgyi/ zhus pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa bzhin/ /nyams su blangs na byin rlabs 'byung*/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gzugs la/ /mos pa byas pas don 'byung na/ /don nyams su len la lta ci smos/ gsungs/ bzlas pa tsam gyis don 'byung na/ /don nyams su blang na smos ci dgos/ /nyams su longs shig rigs kyi bu/ /skal ldan la sogs drangs shig rigs kyi bu/

/ gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ / nyams su len pa la gnad kyi gdams pa ji ltar 'tshal/ zhus pas/ e ma ho/ rigs kyi bu/ gnas ni ri khrod 'grims par gces/ /lus gnad rtsa bzhi klod pa gces/ /ngag gnad nyams dbyangs len pa gces/ /sems gnad 'du shes klod pa gces/ / nyams myong gnad kyis bskyangs pa yin/ /mnyam rjes gnyis su med par bde/ / gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /mnyam rjes gnyis su med par khyer na yon tan ji ltar 'byung zhus pas/ e ma hoḥ rigs kyi bu/ rigs dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /da ni btsal du ci yang med/ /nyin mor gsal la 'dzin med khyer/ /mtshan mor 'byar nyal 'khris med khyer/ /rtag tu tshogs drug lhug par zhog /de ni nga yi 'khyer so yin/ /gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ / ma gcig dgongs par ji ltar gshegs/ /'da' khar lam khyer ji ltar bgyi/ / zhus pas/ skye med ngang la dgongs pa med/ /'gag med ngang la gshegs yul med/ /'dzin med ngang la dus gsum med/ /lhan ne lhang nge lham me tsam/ / rigs kyi bu yis de dgongs na/ /skye med ngang la 'pho 'gyur med/ /sgyu lus zhig kyang gsal 'debs yin/ /'chi kha'i gdams ngag ltos pa med/ / gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /ma yis bstan pa'i gdams pa 'di/ / thos pa tsam gyis grol ba ji ltar mchis/ /zhus pas/ gang zhig skal ldan las can la/ /lan gcig tsam gyis grol bar nges/ /'ga' dang 'ga' yi spyod yul min/ /de bas nan tan bya ba gces/ /go ba gting nas ma lon na/ /tshig nyan tsam la thag ma bcad/ /de ltar dgongs shig rigs kyi bu/ /nga yi gdams ngag bdud slong 'di/ /skal ldan rnams kyi rgyan du che/ / skal med rnams kyi sdig mor che/ /gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ / zhal nas gsungs pa'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /skal ldan nyams su blangs pa la/ / 'byung ba'i tshad ni ji ltar lags/ /zhus pas/ e ma ho/ rigs kyi bu/

bag la nyal dang dngos su rgyur/ /thog tu byung ba'i rkyen rnams la/ /nga yi gdams ngag gnad 'di yis/ /mi phod brdzis te gcod byas nas/ /bar do gsum gyi 'jigs pa sel/ / bdud rnams rang sar grol bar 'gyur/ /de nyid 'byongs pa'i rtags bstan pa/ / dgra gnyen gnyis su mi phyed dang*/ /'dzin pa chos brgyad mi phyed dang*/ /gnyid log sad par mi phyed dang*/ /rmi lam sgyu mar mi phyed dang*/ /dran dang mi dran mi phyed dang*/ /srid pa bar do mi mthong dang*/ /tshe 'di nyid la mngon sangs rgyas/ / de la skye med ngos bzungs la/ /mi phod 'khrul pa bag chags sbyangs/ /e ma ho/ rang snyems chod pas bdud rnams zhi/ /rtsa bral rtogs pas mngon sangs rgyas/ / snyems thag chod pas lhug par zhog /dang po'i sems la bdud ngos bzung*/ / gnyis 'dzin rtog pa skyes su chug /ye shes 'khor 'das gnyis med la/ /blo yis ma dgag rigs kyi bu/ /cir snang gzugs su ma 'dzin cig /zhen med gcod yul lhag par zhog /mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /dad ldan blo gros dman pa la/ /nyams kyi khrid thabs ji ltar bgyi/ /zhus pas/ dad ldan blo gros dman pa la/ /rim gyis khrid par bya ba la/ /dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tsam/ /de nas thabs kyi yan lag la/ /brten nas 'jig pa brtsam par bya/ / brtan par gyur nas phyung ba la/ /nga yi 'khyer so bstan par bya/ /ma gcig skal ldan blo brtan la/ /theg pa'i man ngag bstan par bya/ /dad ldan g.yang la mi bskyur zhing*/ /blo ldan grogs su zhu mi bya/ /gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /blo ldan thabs kyi yan lag la/ /slob tshul ji ltar slob par bgyi/ / zhus pas/ sngon tshe rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /sher phyin a ru bsdus te gsungs/ /rang sems skye med don gyi a/ /gnas ni zag bcas lus la gnas/ khyab ni snang srid kun la khyab/ /'byung ni skyon yon thams cad 'byung*/ / bla ma la gus slob ma yin/

/'khor ba dag la skyo ba skyes/ /skye med don la dung ba skye/ /lus sgrim sems gus dmigs pa bca'/ /a dang thig le dkar dmar la/ /phyi nang spros shing drag tu gtad/ /res 'ga' skyes bu mda' 'phang bzhin/ / mkha' la 'phangs te lus sems phral/ /res 'ga' rlung sbyangs nam mkha' sbyor/ /res 'ga' phung po ar bsam la/ /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i gsal yang gdab/ /skye med bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de la sogs pa nyams dang sbyar/ / gnad du go na 'di yin med/ /goms pa byas nas rang nyams skye/ /gnas la ma zhen byang chub lam/ /gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /gang zhig dmigs med sgom pa la/ /bying rgod byung na ji ltar bgyi/ /zhus pas/ e ma ho/ legs so rigs kyi bu/ dper na yur ba gsar pa nas/ /chu ni legs par drangs pa'i tshe/ /dang po thog rdug med mod kyang*/ /sa rdul gang nas yur kong chad/ /de nyid ma gsos don med 'gyur/ /de gzhin gang zhig sgom pa'i tshe/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs thog mar bde/ /nges shes ma thob the tshom skye/ / nyams su blangs na bying rgod 'byung*/ /bying pa la yang rnam gnyis te/ /'byung bzhi'i stobs kyis byings ba ni/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang me/ /gang ltar bying bar gyur kyang ni/ / ri bo'i rtse la lus bsrang ste/ /rkang gshibs lag gnyis spyi bor sbyar/ /snod bcud phyi nang 'byung ba bzhi/ /rim gyis bsdus la rang la bstims/ /lus kyang me long has btab bzhin/ /snying khams tsam du sems la bstims/ /sems ni nam mkha' rang grol te/ /nam mkha'i ngang la ma bral bya/ / gnyid dang rmugs pas myos byed cing*/ /shes pa 'thibs cing snying mi dga'/ / de ltar byung na yi dwags yin/ /de nyid ngos bzung 'dre rtsad bcad/ /yid btang yod pas nyal bas sobs/ /rgod pa la yang rnam gnyis te/ /rlung gi stobs kyis 'phro ba dang*/ / bar chad bgegs kyis 'phro ba 'o/ /ji ltar 'phro rgod cir snang yang*/

khang pa stong pa'i rkun ma dang*/ /bar snang stong pa'i sprin bzhin du/ /gzhi rtsa med par rtogs pas zhi/ /yang na slar la rab spros te/ /yengs med kun tu rtsal sbyangs pas/ /bying rgod rang sar grol bar nges/ /gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /bying rgod gnyis skyon gang che zhus pas/ bying ba dang ni rgod pa gnyis/ / bying ba gti mug shas che bas/ /lhag mthong ye shes skye mi 'gyur/ /lhag mthong ye shes ma skye na/ /rlung dus phyi ba nyal ba bzhin/ /zhi gnas rlung sgom lam mi bsgrod/ /rgod pa ye shes shas che bas/ /rtse gcig don la ma gnas kyang*/ / sems nyid gsal la dngas pa des/ /rnam rtog 'phro yang yon tan yin/ /dri mas dri ma 'khrus pa bzhin/ /rtog pas rtog pa sel bar 'gyur/ /rtog med rang sar shugs kyis 'char/ / gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /lus la na tsha byung na ji ltar bgyi/ /sems la sdug bsngal byung na ji ltar bgyi/ /zhes zhus pas/ lus la na tsha byung srid na/ /sgyu ma'i lus la chags pa dbral/ /sos nas dga' ba'i sems mi skyed/ /gnyan sar song la rnal 'byor kun/ /lus po gtub la tshogs su 'bul/ /rnam rtog chos nyid gter du sbos/ /bgegs gdon sku drin che bar blta/ /sems la sdug bsngal byung srid na/ /gnas dang dbyibs dang kha dog brtags/ /brtags na ngo bo nyid kyis dben/ /des na sdug bsngal 'dzin mkhan 'khrul/ /mo gsham bu yi spyang grung dang*/ /ri bong rwa yi rno rtul 'dra/ /de nyid med pas de byung med/ /sems kyi gzhi rtsa chod tsam na/ /bde sdug bya ba yod mi srid/ /rnam smin bag chags kun las grol/ /'khor ba'i tha ma de ru thug /rigs kyi bu yis de dgongs nas/ /rkyen ni rab rib gzugs brnyan tsam/ /dper na nam mkha'i cho 'phrul 'dra/ /na tsha sdug bsngal ci byung yang*/ /rtsal sbyong re re shes par bya/ /rkyen snang grogs su ma go na/ /lta ba mtho yang gol ba yin/

/rkyen snang ci byung ci shar yang*/ /dben par song la rnal 'byor kun/ /lus glod sems glod nyams nga thongs/ /'dod pa 'grub pa'i yid ma 'cha'/ /bag dro ngang dal shes pa bde/ /rang la rang gis bsre ba la/ / gzhan la bltas na rnal 'byor min/ /gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ / gzhan la byin rlabs byed na ji ltar bgyi/ dang po phyi yi byin brlab ni/ /sems skyo nyams dbyangs len pa dang*/ /spyod lam gleng bar byas pa yis/ /gzhan mos skye bas byin brlabs 'byung*/ /nang gi byin brlab bya ba ni/ /'dre dang nad pa rang gi sems/ /gnyis med gcig gi ngang du bzhag /sdug bsngal zhi bas byin brlab 'byung*/ /gsang ba'i byin brlab bya ba ni/ /byin ni 'gyur ba med pa yin/ /brlabs ni 'gags med shugs las 'byung*/ /rang nyid nyams dang ldan byas nas/ /rtsa bral dri med ngang bzhag pas/ /byin brlab 'bad pa med par 'byung*/ /bdag dang bcas pa'i byin rlab ni/ /byin dang mi ldan nus pa med/ / gzhan don byas kyang 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /nyams len yar skyed chung ba dang*/ /shes pa'i sna kha 'khor na ji ltar bgyi/ zhus pas/ e ma ho/ thams cad ma lus chos nyid ngang*/ /chos nyid ngang la skye ba med/ /skye med nam mkha'i dkyil dang 'dra/ /chos nyid ngang la 'gags pa med// 'gags med nam mkha'i klong dang 'dra/ /chos nyid ngang la 'pho 'gyur med/ / 'gyur med nam mkha'i dbyings dang 'dra/ /chos nyid ngang la 'grib pa med/ / 'grib med nyi ma'i snying po 'dra/ /chos nyid ngang la rtsol sgrub med/ /rtsol med nam mkha'i khyung chen 'dra/ /rtogs na ye shes chig chod yin/ /rnal 'byor sa lam shugs kyis bsgrod/ /blo sbyong nyams la rtsis gdab med/ /ye stong ngang du blo gros sangs/ /rig pa'i sna kha 'khor dgos med/ /de ltar dgongs na rigs kyi bu/ /gang zhig skal dman byis pa'i tshogs/ /ma rig rig par shes pa na/

/ ma rig spangs ba'i pha rol na/ /rig pa 'tshol ba snying re rje/ /btsal bas mi rnyed nyon re mongs/ /chos can chos nyid mi shes pas/ /chos nyid 'tshol ba snying re rje/ /btsal bas ma rnyed nyon re mongs/ /rnam rtog ye shes ma shes pas/ / rnam rtog spang pa'i pha rol na/ /ye shes 'tshol ba snying re rje/ /btsal bas mi rnyed nyon re mongs/ /sems can sangs rgyas ma shes pas/ /sems can spangs pa'i pha rol na/ /sangs rgyas 'tshol ba snying re rje/ /btsal bas mi rnyed nyon re mongs/ /'khor ba spangs pa'i pha rol na/ /myang 'das 'tshol ba snying re rje/ / btsal bas mi rnyed nyon re mongs/ /ma rig rgan mo long ba 'dra/ /mtshan ldan bla ma shin tu gces/ /ma rtogs shes pa spre 'u 'dra/ /brgyud pa'i gdams ngag shin tu gces/ /tshig gi kha ta ne tso 'dra/ /nyams su blangs pa shin tu gces/ /blos byas rnam rtog na bun 'dra/ /rig pa chun pa shin tu gces/ /tshogs gnyis shing rta'i 'khor lo 'dra/ /zung du 'jug pa shin tu gces/ /'khrul pa'i bag chags gcong nad 'dra/ /thog tu 'gel ba shin tu gces/ /gsungs/ mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /gcod yul 'di gzhan la spel lam mi spel zhus pas/ khyod kyis spel bas mi 'phel gyi/ /dad ldan brtson 'grus che ba dang*/ /dam tshig srungs shing blo ldan rnams/ /dad cing 'dun na bstan par mdzod/ /rkyen gyis bdas pa'i gang zag la/ /zhal gyi gdams pa nan cher thob/ /nad sos ci 'gyur cha med pas/ /lag len bstan par mi bya 'o/ /gang zag snod la brtags pa las/ /nor gyi phyir du bka' mnos min/ /'on kyang nor la brtags na mngon/ /'di phyir gtong bar mi nus na/ /nges par skal dman rmongs pa'i rigs/ /'jug sgo tsam zhig ma gtogs pa/ /tha ma'i gdams ngag bstan mi bya/ /brtags shing 'brel la brtags par mdzod/ /bla ma la gus snying rje che/ / gtong ba che zhing blo che ba/ /bya ba btang zhing tha snyad med/

/de ni skal ldan las can yin/ /bsdu ba che zhing gzhan don byed/ /ces so/ bka' tshoms kyi zhus lan sum cu so lnga pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i thugs yang gsang thugs kyi nying khu rdzogs so// // na mo gu ru/ ma gcig lab sgron gyi zhal nas/ nga gnyan sa ri khrod dgon pa 'grims tsa na/ /gnyis med lta ba'i gdengs gis gcod pa yin/ /gdon gnod sbyin cho 'phrul byung tsa na/ /phung po gzan du bskyur ba yin/ /lus la na tsha byung tsa na/ /rig pa rten dang phral ba yin/ /g.ya' gong gangs khrod dgon pa 'grims tsa na/ /ro snyoms kyi spyod pa byed pa yin/ /rang re gcig pur 'dug tsa na/ /ma yengs don la lta ba yin/ /rig pa 'phro zhing rgod tsa na/ /gnas lugs steng du 'jog pa yin/ /gti mug 'thib gsum byung tsa na/ /sems dang nam mkha' bsre ba yin/ /'jigs pa'i gnas su nyal tsa na/ /sems kyis lus 'khri gcod pa yin/ /lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul byung tsa na/ /nyams len grogs su 'khyer ba yin/ /snyems dang rtogs pa byung tsa na/ /de yi steng du bskyur ba yin/ / mi gtsang 'go 'dzoms byung tsa na/ /mdze klad dron mo ldag pa yin/ /gnyis med lta bas gcod tsa na/ /lha 'dre rang sar grol ba yin/ /bsgoms pas nyams su len tsa na/ /rnam rtog thog rdzis byed pa yin/ /rtog med spyod pa byed tsa na/ / mdze klad dron mo 'thung ba yin/ /sku gsum 'bras bu tshol tsa na/ /the tshom mdud pa dkrol ba yin/ /rkyen ngan grogs su 'khyer tsa na/ /ltas ngan g.yang du len pa yin/ /rgyal khams phyogs med bskor tsa na/ /pha yul gyi 'khri ba gcod pa yin/ /

mdze sprang slob dpon byed tsa na/ /byams dang snying rje sgom pa yin/ / yid ches gtso bor 'dzin tsa na/ /the tshom mdud pa bkrol ba yin/ /longs spyod g.yang la bskyur tsa na/ /phyogs med du zas ngan za ba yin/ /rigs drug g.yang sa gcod tsa na/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams 'joms pa yin/ /gnas lugs steng du bzhag tsa na/ /gnyis med rang sar grol ba yin/ /snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/ /ngo bo sems su 'dus pa yin/ /gegs sel nyi shu rtsa gcig 'di/ / ma cig lab kyi sgron ma nyid kyis gsungs pa yin/ 'di la gzigs shing sems la ltos/ /'di ltar khel na chos pa yin/ /ma gcig gi bka' tshoms chen mo rdzogs so// //maṅgal// shu bhaṃ/ dge'o// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (26)ma gcig gi bka' tshoms/ - PAGE 310 -- PAGE 309 -- PAGE 291 -
